record.note: Scoped semantic review of five Issue types and evidence-preserving transitions, plus minimal complete changes and evidence-based review under the same workflow authority. Reuse respects responsibility boundaries, simplification preserves required behavior and validation, and non-blocking advice adds no approval or evidence chain. Classification is separate from execution permission; closed issues remain historical references. Forms and dot/TPM consumers reference this authority. Online labels, historical migration and recurring execution are not claimed enabled. Unchanged sections retain existing authority.
